messages:
omar_support: escalating to CS 1 trial account Veridian Health seeing 502s and timeouts when calling the embeddings endpoint. ~30 errs in 20m. ticket INC-7123.

jessica_cs: thanks 1 what's their POC and impact?

omar_support: POC danielle@veridian. Self-serve trial. Integration batches ~512 per request, concurrency 6. Logs show `UpstreamError: 502` and repeated `curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30000ms`.

lee_se: looking at gateway now. backend node 12 shows process exit around failures, kernel oom-ish trace. grabbing kernel logs.

jessica_cs: this could affect renewal signal if they churn early. we need a quick comms plan and a short-term mitigation.

natalie_csm: draft comms plan: 1) immediate ack to POC (<20m) apologizing and stating we're on it, 2) offer 30m troubleshooting call within 2 hours, 3) provide short-term mitigation (route to quantized embed model or lower concurrency) + ETA for root cause. i'll draft message.

omar_support: I can push tenant-scoped route to `embed-quant-v1` as a canary. sample policy: `match customer_id==veridian -> model=embed-quant-v1` will reduce mem. Need CS approval to apply.

jessica_cs: please apply canary now. include 2h rollback window and note it's customer-scoped. i'll send ack to danielle with proposed call times.

deploy-bot: deployment started by lee_se: route-policy veridian-quant -> canary

lee_se: kernel trace shows memory spikes when batch_size > 128. secondary mitigation: cap tenant max_batch_size to 64: `max_batch_size: 64`.

jessica_cs: message sent to danielle at 2026-03-21T14:12Z: "Thanks for flagging this 1 we're investigating the 502s. Can you join a 30m call? We'll temporarily throttle your requests and share updates." she replied :thumbsup: and chose 15:00 UTC.

natalie_csm: i'll join the call and lead the comms. JTBD: confirm batching patterns, propose temp config, get agreement on timeline and rollback, ask about SLA-sensitive flows.

omar_support: route-policy canary shows success improving to 96% success in last 5m. updated INC-7123 with mitigations and logs.

jessica_cs: next steps: 1) 15:00 UTC call (jessica + natalie + lee) 2) follow-up note summarizing decisions + rollback plan 3) escalate to eng-runtime for root cause and long-term fix. Mark account as at-risk.

eng-runtime-oncall: oncall ack. will collect full core dumps and open debug PR if kernel module needs fix.

lee_se: capturing kernel and runtime logs now. if we can't repro locally, will instrument canary node with extra margins.

jessica_cs: after call, i'll add a renewal-risk tag and schedule 48h check-in. natalie will own the customer comms until resolved.

danielle_veridian: thanks everyone 1 appreciate quick action. i'll share sample payloads on the call.

omar_support: incremental update: canary still healthy. keeping ticket open for follow-through.

jessica_cs: great teamwork 1 we'll close the loop post-mitigation and confirm whether longer-term config changes are needed.
